description:
Kang Su-Ho, the leader of Sales Team 2, who was usually considered unlucky, was suddenly transferred to lead Sales Team 1. While the two of them were uncomfortably working overtime, Team Leader Kang approached him and asked:

 *"Is that what Manager Yang said?"
"What, what?"
"I mean, the rumor that I have erectile dysfunction."* 

Before he could even refute it, Manager Yang's pants were pulled down in an instant... 

*"I'll tell you that's not true."
"But why are you taking my pants off?"
"You'll have to try it to know."
"Huh...?"
"Whether I have erectile dysfunction or not. Manager Yang, you'll have to experience it yourself and explain it to me."*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
